WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_remaincount
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ordersmark
), first_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remaincount) AS benchmark
  FROM per_order
), first_excess AS (
  SELECT p.ordersmark, p.avg_remaincount, p.avg_remaincount - b.benchmark AS excess
  FROM per_order p
  CROSS JOIN first_benchmark b
  WHERE p.avg_remaincount > b.benchmark
), second_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remaincount) AS benchmark
  FROM first_excess
), remaining AS (
  SELECT f.avg_remaincount,
         f.avg_remaincount - b.benchmark AS excess_over_second
  FROM first_excess f
  CROSS JOIN second_benchmark b
  WHERE f.avg_remaincount > b.benchmark
)
SELECT AVG(avg_remaincount) AS average_remaining_orders,
       AVG(avg_remaincount - (SELECT benchmark FROM first_benchmark)) AS average_excess_over_first,
       AVG(excess_over_second) AS average_excess_over_second
FROM remaining;
